text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Very little time remains until the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
The venue facilities are gradually coming 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up most of my meetings, 
I finally have a moment to catch my 
breath. 
Who else did I want to talk to before the 
main event...?
choice_data_list: Daiwa Scarlet
Mayano Top Gun
Yukino Bijin
No Reason
Blast Onepiece
Azuma

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Daiwa Scarlet's personality, 
her whereabouts are easy enough to guess. 
I stop by the program grounds and find 
her—
choice_data_list: Practicing on your own again?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just one more shot, then I'll take a 
break.
choice_data_list: I know. I won't stop you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So? Did you need something?
choice_data_list: Do you have any lingering worries left?
No lingering worries left on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just a question to be sure. 
Knowing what she thinks and how much she 
endures— 
after three years, I've come to understand 
that well.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......Dummy. You don't need to worry about 
that now. 
If there was anything, I'd have told you 
ages ago.
choice_data_list: Really?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Really. 
So you, too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Have a little more confidence in 
yourself. 
When it comes to being there for an 
Umamusume's worries, 
you're actually pretty good at it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, someone at a food stall just told me! 
Apparently there's a mountain near Kobe 
with a name just like Maya's~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For this Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
people have come from all regions to show 
support. 
She seems to have struck up a conversation 
with one of them.
choice_data_list:
I bet some people start rooting for you 
just because of your name.

Some folks might end up cheering for you 
just because of your name, too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right?! And once they see Maya run 
super-duper strong~... 
Every last one of 'em's gonna fall head 
over heels for Maya☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Maya's such a dangerous woman~♪ 
Makin' everyone totally swoon over her♡
choice_data_list:
Though being swooned over by you probably 
makes them pretty happy.

Though being swooned over by you might 
make them happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Watching a strong Umamusume gives people 
courage.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Does that go for people like you, too? 
Every single "person" out there?
choice_data_list:
That's right, the folks from Kobe, too! 
Everyone connected to you!

That's right, the folks from Kobe, too! 
Everyone connected to you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
! Then Maya'll make 'em fall even harder! 
'Cause Maya's a super strong Umamusume!! 
............I'm gonna keep all their eyes 
glued on me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is bright and spirited. 
Because of who she is, there's darkness 
only she could illuminate. 
—Reflecting on that, I spend a quiet 
moment with her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! 
Mifuyu-chan, you can come watch the actual 
event too!?
choice_data_list: (...Whoops, looks like she's on a call.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I approach Yukino Bijin, 
she seems to be on a call with her 
hometown friends. 
Maybe I should head back for now and come 
back later...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! 
Mifuyu-chan, Trainer just walked over!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Really?! 
Excuse us, Trainer! 
Do you have a quick second right now—?!"
choice_data_list: Whoa?! Ah, yeah! I'm good, but...
Whoa?! Uh, yeah! I'm good, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beckoned over by Yukino Bijin, 
I'm guided to her side. And displayed on 
her smartphone screen are—

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu & Villagers
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please take good care of our 
Yuki-chan!" 
"We're countin' on ya to look after our 
Yukino!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Once I told 'em how well ya take care of 
me, 
everyone just couldn't help themselves. 
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the warm trust of Yukino Bijin 
and her hometown folks. 
...I want to keep doing everything I can 
for her moving forward. 
That feeling settles firmly in my heart.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Wouldst thou have some as well? 
Lord Acute sent over these boiled beans as 
a token of encouragement!
choice_data_list: Sweet boiled beans... That takes me back.
Sweet boiled beans... That takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take a bite of the beans offered by No 
Reason. 
The flavor is—
choice_data_list: ...Sweet.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye, simmered in sugar. 
'Tis this very flavor of the modern age 
that suits my palate so well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Even this Goshiki Shuntaisai 
hath taken on a "modern" form quite to my 
liking.
choice_data_list: Do you like the new format as well?
Do you like the new format as well?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Were it otherwise, I'd have raised the 
banner of rebellion! 
'Overthrow the rulers!'
choice_data_list: Haha, the No Reason Rebellion, huh?
Heheh, the No Reason Rebellion, huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet no such rebellion came to pass. 
...Which means, at least for me, 
it was by no means a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving No Reason's affirmation brings a 
wave of relief. 
Recalling the days she led me forward... 
I pop another bean into my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Eat with me, Trainer~~! 
The mister at the food stall gave this to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumbleee...!)
choice_data_list: Haha, you go ahead and eat it all, Blast.
Hehe, you go ahead and eat it all, Blast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know full well what a big eater she is. 
That's why I want her, of all people, 
to enjoy delicious food to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: No way!
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Boo wants us to split it! 
Just like you've done with me all this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Both the 'fun times' and the 'tough 
times'! 
If the two of us share them 
half-and-half... 
they become memories that belong to both 
of us, right?
choice_data_list: Even this yakisoba?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her enthusiasm, I pick up 
my chopsticks. 
And together with Blast Onepiece, I add 
another 
cherished memory to our collection.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
choice_data_list: (Wait, what Azuma-san is holding is—)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
An ancient musubi-ita wooden tablet. 
This, too, is a piece of history.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
The miracles forged by names 
are truly wondrous things.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For instance, simply having one's name 
spoken by you. 
Even that alone is felt as a miracle 
by some Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Does that apply to you as well, Azuma-san?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... 
It may very well be so.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Because I possessed a name, 
I was able to have "me" known to you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
One individual, meeting another individual 
as themselves.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...That, too, is something 
I wish to call a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Azuma-san clasps the tablet 
once more 
and begins to pray. Careful not to disturb 
her prayers, 
I quietly watch over her.

title: A Moment Before the Main Stage
